title: Remote Team Collaboration
pains: Difficulty in maintaining effective communication and collaboration among remote team members, leading to decreased productivity and project delays.
evidence: Tools like Slack and Zoom are widely adopted with subscription models indicating high demand for remote collaboration solutions.

title: Personal Finance Management
pains: Struggling to manage personal finances, leading to debt accumulation and stress about financial security.
evidence: Apps like Mint and YNAB charge subscription fees and have large user bases, showing that people are willing to pay for effective financial management tools.

title: Mental Health Support
pains: Increasing levels of anxiety and depression, with individuals seeking support and coping strategies.
evidence: Platforms like BetterHelp and Talkspace offer paid therapy sessions online, reflecting a strong market for mental health services.
